section_summary.extract_value: This procedure section describes a single study (Study X) where researchers translated BAS-2 items into Cantonese and recruited participants from classroom settings between November 2014 and April 2015. Participants completed questionnaires individually in a paper-and-pencil format in classroom settings, with randomized scale presentation order and anonymous responses.
